2703-the-argonauts-of-north-liberty.creator: Bret Harte
2703-the-argonauts-of-north-liberty.description: A book by Bret Harte. The dry, monotonous disturbance of the bell had given way to the strain of a bass viol, that had been apparently pitched to the key of the east wind without, and the crude complaint of a new harmonium that seemed to bewail its limited prospect of ever becoming seasoned or mellowed in its earthly tabernacle, and then the singing began.

arxiv-2108-12902.title: A multispecies pseudoadiabat for simulating condensable-rich exoplanet atmospheres
arxiv-2108-12902.creator: R.J. Graham, Tim Lichtenberg, Ryan Boukrouche, Raymond T. Pierrehumbert
arxiv-2108-12902.description: Abstract Central stages in the evolution of rocky, potentially habitable planets may play out under atmospheric conditions with a large inventory of non-dilute condensable components. Variations in condensate retention and accompanying changes in local lapse rate may substantially affect planetary climate and surface conditions, but there is currently no general theory to effectively describe such atmospheres.

arxiv-2308-01786.title: Unique properties of the optical activity in noncentrosymmetric superconductors: sum rule, missing area, and relation with the superconducting Edelstein effect
arxiv-2308-01786.creator: Koki Shinada, Robert Peters
arxiv-2308-01786.description: Abstract We present general properties of the optical activity in noncentrosymmetric materials, including superconductors. We derive a sum rule of the optical activity in general electric states and show that the summation of the spectrum is zero, which is independent of the details of electric states. The optical activity has a δ \delta -function singularity that vanishes in normal phases.

arxiv-2311-09681.title: Quasiconformal curves and quasiconformal maps in metric spaces
arxiv-2311-09681.creator: Lauri Hitruhin, Athanasios Tsantaris
arxiv-2311-09681.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lauri Hitruhin, Athanasios Tsantaris. In this paper we study quasiconformal curves which are a special case of quasiregular curves. Namely embeddings Ω → ℝ m \Omega\to\mathbb{R}^{m} from some domain Ω ⊂ ℝ n \Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{n} to ℝ m \mathbb{R}^{m} , where n ≤ m n\leq m , which belong in a suitable Sobolev class and satisfy a certain distortion inequality for some smooth, closed and non-vanishing n n -form in ℝ m \mathbb{R}^{m} .

arxiv-2401-15877.title: 3DPFIX: Improving Remote Novices’ 3D Printing Troubleshooting through Human-AI Collaboration Journal: PACMHCI Volume: 8 CSCW1 11 4 DOI: 10.1145/3637288 CCS: Human-centered computing Collaborative and social computing systems and tools CCS: Computing methodologies Computer vision CCS: Human-centered
arxiv-2401-15877.creator: Nahyun Kwon, Tong Sun, Yuyang Gao, Liang Zhao, Xu Wang, Jeeeun Kim, Sungsoo Ray Hong
arxiv-2401-15877.description: Abstract . The widespread consumer-grade 3D printers and learning resources online enable novices to self-train in remote settings. While troubleshooting plays an essential part of 3D printing, the process remains challenging for many remote novices even with the help of well-developed online sources, such as online troubleshooting archives and online community help.

arxiv-2409-17479.title: Traverse the Non-Traversable: Estimating Traversability for Wheeled Mobility on Vertically Challenging Terrain
arxiv-2409-17479.creator: Chenhui Pan, Aniket Datar, Anuj Pokhrel, Matthew Choulas, Mohammad Nazeri, Xuesu Xiao
arxiv-2409-17479.description: Abstract Most traversability estimation techniques divide off-road terrain into traversable (e.g., pavement, gravel, and grass) and non-traversable (e.g., boulders, vegetation, and ditches) regions and then inform subsequent planners to produce trajectories on the traversable part. However, recent research demonstrated that wheeled robots can traverse vertically challenging terrain (e.g.

arxiv-2412-13974.title: On the order of 4-dimensional regular polytope numbers
arxiv-2412-13974.creator: Anji Dong, The Nguyen, Alexandru Zaharescu
arxiv-2412-13974.description: Abstract . In light of Kim’s conjecture on regular polytopes of dimension four, which is a generalization of Waring’s problem, we establish asymptotic formulas for representing any sufficiently large integer as a sum of numbers in the form of those regular 4-polytopes.

arxiv-2509-09693.title: Glorbit: A Modular, Web-Based Platform for AI Based Periorbital Measurement in Low-Resource Settings
arxiv-2509-09693.creator: George R. Nahass, Jacob van der Ende, Sasha Hubschman, Benjamin Beltran, Bhavana Kolli, Caitlin Berek, James D. Edmonds, R.V. Paul Chan, Pete Setabutr*, James W. Larrick, Darvin Yi, Ann Q. Tran
arxiv-2509-09693.description: Abstract Periorbital measurements such as margin reflex distances (MRD1/2), palpebral fissure height, and scleral show are critical in diagnosing and managing conditions like ptosis and disorders of the eyelid. We developed and evaluated Glorbit, a lightweight, browser-based application for automated periorbital distance measurement using artificial intelligence (AI), designed for deployment in low-resource clinical environments.

arxiv-2510-20672.title: An Axial-Vector Leptophilic Fifth Force Sourced by Solar Neutrinos
arxiv-2510-20672.creator: Rundong Fang, Ji-Heng Guo, Jia Liu, Xiao-Ping Wang, YanLi Zhao
arxiv-2510-20672.description: Abstract We investigate long-range, purely leptophilic axial–vector interactions mediated by a light gauge boson A ′ A^{\prime} that couples to charged leptons and, by weak symmetry, to left-handed neutrinos. We analyze two realizations, a minimal effective model with muon-only couplings and an anomaly-free axial U ​ ( 1 ) ′ U(1)^{\prime} with inter-generation cancellations.

arxiv-2511-11109.title: CPT SYMMETRY IN THE MIRROR UNIVERSE
arxiv-2511-11109.creator: Natalia Gorobey, Alexander Lukyanenko, A. V. Goltsev
arxiv-2511-11109.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Natalia Gorobey, Alexander Lukyanenko, A. V. Goltsev. A model of a two-sheeted universe in the quantum theory of gravity is proposed, based on the definition of 3D invariant and gauge-invariant proper time of the universe. A uniform time in a closed universe is introduced in the class of equivalent reference systems defined by the spectrum of a Hermitian 3D operator on the space of Dirac bi-spinors, the equality to zero of which is equivalent to a system of gravitational constraints.

arxiv-2512-11300.title: Distributed Quantum Magnetic Sensing for Infrastructure-free Geo-localization
arxiv-2512-11300.creator: Thinh Le, Shiqian Guo, Jianqing Liu
arxiv-2512-11300.description: Abstract Modern navigation systems rely heavily on Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS), whose weak spaceborne signals are vulnerable to jamming, spoofing, and line-of-sight blockage. As an alternative, the Earth’s magnetic field entails location information and is found critical to many animals’ cognitive and navigation behavior.

Mutant embryos lack expression of isl1 and sst in the endocrine pancreas, but retain isl1 expression in the CNS. Non-endocrine endodermal gene expression is less affected in the mutant, with varying degrees of

pmc-10655975.title: Supplementing dairy feed by dicalcium phosphate and effect on dry matter intake, digestibility, milk composition, and blood mineral balances in crossbred dairy cows
pmc-10655975.creator: Wondewsen Bekele Wondater, Tilaye Demissie Ayanie, Ewa Tomaszewska, Ewa Tomaszewska, Ewa Tomaszewska
pmc-10655975.description: The present study was conducted to assess if Dicalcium Phosphate 18% (DCP) supplementation in dairy feed would affect dry matter intake, milk composition, blood mineral balance and milk production in lactating crossbred Dairy Cows). A 4 × 4 double change-over design set as Latin Squares was used to do feeding and digestibility trials.

pmc-10743650.title: Incidence of New-Onset Inflammatory Bowel Disease, Oral and Gastrointestinal Candidiasis, Herpes Zoster, Pulmonary Tuberculosis, and Major Cardiovascular Events in Patients with Moderate-to-Severe Psoriasis Exposed to Biologics
pmc-10743650.creator: Da-Hyun Kang, Bark-Lynn Lew, Soon-Hyo Kwon, Alan Fleischer
pmc-10743650.description: The multicenter, retrospective cohort study was aimed at examining adverse events in biologic-treated patients with moderate-to-severe psoriasis by using a real-world database. Thus, we analyzed exposure-adjusted incidence rates for new-onset inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), oral and gastrointestinal candidiasis, pulmonary tuberculosis, herpes zoster, and major cardiovascular events (MACEs) in biologic-treated patients with moderate-to-severe psoriasis.

pmc-11489964.title: Children’s out-of-home placements: Associations with parental substance use and neighbourhood sociodemographics
pmc-11489964.creator: Kirsimarja Raitasalo, Karoliina Karjalainen, Sanna Kärkkäinen, Timo M Kauppinen
pmc-11489964.description: Background: Studies have shown an association between parental problematic substance use (PSU) and children's out-of-home care (OHC). But there is little researech on the kind of urban neighbourhoods in which such associations typically show up. This study aims to shed light on the associations between neighbourhood characteristics, parental PSU and children's OHC.

pmc-11602941.title: TGFβ family signaling in human stem cell self-renewal and differentiation
pmc-11602941.creator: Sijia Liu, Jiang Ren, Yanmei Hu, Fangfang Zhou, Long Zhang
pmc-11602941.description: Human stem cells are undifferentiated cells with the capacity for self-renewal and differentiation into distinct cell lineages, playing important role in the development and maintenance of diverse tissues and organs. The microenvironment of stem cell provides crucial factors and components that exert significant influence over the determination of cell fate.

pmc-11618380.title: Oncometabolites at the crossroads of genetic, epigenetic and ecological alterations in cancer
pmc-11618380.creator: Letizia Lanzetti
pmc-11618380.description: By the time a tumor reaches clinical detectability, it contains around 108–109 cells. However, during tumor formation, significant cell loss occurs due to cell death. In some estimates, it could take up to a thousand cell generations, over a ~ 20-year life-span of a tumor, to reach clinical detectability, which would correspond to a “theoretical” generation of ~1030 cells.

pmc-11659956.title: Brain spatial reconciliation through multisensory integration in the impact of pandemic fatigue on workplace
pmc-11659956.creator: Rizka Tri Arinta, Prasasto Satwiko, Robert Rianto Widjaja, Sri Kusrohmaniah
pmc-11659956.description: The COVID-19 pandemic has highlighted the prevalence of fatigue, reduced interpersonal interaction, and heightened stress in work environments. The intersection of neuroscience and architecture underscores how intricate spatial perceptions are shaped by multisensory stimuli, profoundly influencing workers’ wellbeing. In this study, EEG and VR technologies, specifically the Emotiv Epoc X, were employed to gather data on perception and cognition.

pmc-11710071.title: Serial‐position effect in participants cognitively unimpaired with Subjective Cognitive Complaints (SCCs) and with Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) that revert, remain stable or worsen: Evidence from the Compostela Aging study (CompAS)
pmc-11710071.creator: Arturo X Pereiro Rozas, Maria Campos‐Magdaleno, Cristina Lojo‐Seoane, Lucía Pérez‐Blanco, Sabela Carme Mallo, Sonali Arora, Fátima Fernández‐Feijoo, David Facal
pmc-11710071.description: BackgroundHigher recency effect in episodic memory (EM) has been found for MCI and dementia (Martin et al., 2013; Campos et al., 2016). Additional research should be conducted on the pre‐symptomatic stages and on their ability to predict progression to cognitive decline.

pmc-12550001.title: Entropy and heat transfer in (SWCNTs)/(C2H6O2–H2O) 50:50% dissipative nanofluidic system: application of Kyamada–ota model
pmc-12550001.creator: Adnan, Seham M Al-Mekhlafi, Mutasem Z Bani-Fwaz, Muhammad Nasir Bashir
pmc-12550001.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Use of nanomaterials for improved thermal applications is a vibrant research area. These applications frequently occur in mechanical, thermal, chemical, and paint industries. Selection of individual nanomaterial characteristics is important to achieve fine results. Thus, the current work aims to study a problem by utilizing the unique structural properties of CNTs nanomaterials and (C2H6O2-H2O) 50:50% with key focus on the diameter and length factors involves in the thermal conductivity.

pmc-13029968.title: Rhodnius prolixus Viruses Interfere with Proliferation and Metacyclogenesis of the Chagas Disease Agent Trypanosoma cruzi
pmc-13029968.creator: Maira Arruda Cardoso, Carolina Silva Dias Vieira, Isabel Cristina de Faria Moreira, Francis Monique de Souza Saraiva, Ingrid Alexandre de Abreu Brito, Ana Caroline P. Gandara, Rubem F. S. Menna-Barreto, Pedro L. Oliveira, Marcia Cristina Paes, Attilio Pane
pmc-13029968.description: The protozoan Trypanosoma cruzi is the etiological agent of Chagas disease, a neglected tropical disease that mostly affects the population of Latin American countries, with an estimated 7 million infected people and more than 10,000 deaths per year worldwide. T. cruzi is typically transmitted by hematophagous triatomine insects, with Rhodnius prolixus being a major insect vector in South America.

pmc-13071239.title: Economic burden of type 2 diabetes management in France according to clinical characteristics
pmc-13071239.creator: Bruno Guerci, Christèle Blanc‐Bisson, Eric Vicaut, Gérard De Pouvourville, Bruno Detournay, Corinne Emery, Isabelle Bureau, Taos Ihaddadene‐Salzgeber, Fleur Levrat‐Guillen, Jean‐Pierre Riveline
pmc-13071239.description: AimWe sought to investigate the treatment, medication patterns, and economic burden of type 2 diabetes (T2D) in France.Materials and MethodsThis was a descriptive retrospective cross‐sectional study of a representative sample of adults in the national healthcare system claims database in 2022. Patients with T2D were compared with a propensity‐score‐matched cohort without diabetes.

pmc-13090542.title: Long-standing, multifocal Tuberculosis verrucosa cutis: Undiagnosed for 40 years
pmc-13090542.creator: Seblewengel Maru Wubalem, Helina Melis Kefetew, Saada Yasin Abduselam, Shemsu Abraham Hussien
pmc-13090542.description: BackgroundTuberculosis (TB) is a chronic infectious disease primarily affecting the lungs, with extrapulmonary TB comprising 20% of cases. Among these, cutaneous TB (CTB) accounts for 1–2%, often overlooked due to its rarity and varied presentations. This report highlights an unusual case of Tuberculosis verrucosa cutis (TVC)Case presentationA 60-year-old male, presented with non-healing skin lesion that remained undiagnosed for 40 years.

pmc-13226048.title: Development and translation of biodegradable metal stents: from heart to brain
pmc-13226048.creator: Xiaofeng Cao, Guanjun Chen, Yuchen Fan, Yunong Shen, Ming Li, Yufeng Zheng
pmc-13226048.description: Biodegradable metal stents offer a promising approach for vascular intervention by providing temporary mechanical support and subsequently degrading once healing is complete. While significant progress has been made in cardiovascular applications, their adaptation for cerebrovascular use remains an active area of research. This review systematically examines three key biodegradable metal systems: Fe, Zn and Mg alloys.

pmc-13244798.title: Temperature-Dependent Swelling of Brodie Graphite Oxide in Liquid Primary Amides
pmc-13244798.creator: Gui Li, Nicolas Boulanger, Bartosz Gurzęda, Christoph Hennig, Kristina Kvashnina, Alexandr V Talyzin
pmc-13244798.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Swelling in polar solvents is a fundamental property of graphite oxide (GO). Using in situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction (XRD), Brodie graphite oxide (BGO) swelling was studied in a series of primary amides with the number of carbon atoms in the alkyl chain ranging from one (acetamide) to ten (decanamide) and compared to GO swelling in primary alcohols of equivalent chain lengths. The uptake of solvent due to swelling was determined via Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC).

pmc-13254269.title: Preoperative low Geriatric Nutritional Risk Index increases intensive care unit admission risk in patients undergoing gastrointestinal tumor surgery
pmc-13254269.creator: Wei-De Lin, Bi-Xia Lin, Jun-Fan Chen, Xiao-Ping Huang
pmc-13254269.description: BackgroundGastrointestinal tumors are highly prevalent malignant tumors worldwide, and surgery is their primary treatment modality. Although the Geriatric Nutritional Risk Index (GNRI), a simple nutritional assessment tool, has been associated with prognosis in various diseases, its impact on ICU admission risk following gastrointestinal tumor surgery remains unclear.
